newsitem.title: CHINA: China Aerospace unit FRN raised sharply.
newsitem.headline: China Aerospace unit FRN raised sharply.

text.p: A floating rate note issue guaranteed by China Aerospace International Holdings Ltd has been more than tripled following an enthusiastic response from bankers, arranger Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Monday.

The issue, launched through Casil Clearing Investment BVI Ltd, was increased to US$150 million from US$40 million. The notes are guaranteed by China Aerospace International Holdings, a unit of China Aerospace Corp.
The facility has a final maturity of three years with a put and a call option in year two.
The issue was priced at par to float at 130 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 170 basis points.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is the lead manager.
Co-lead managers are Peregrine Fixed Income, WestLB, NM Rothschild and Sons Hong Kong, China Construction Bank Hong Kong, Credit Lyonnais and Nikko Securities.

Senior managers are Hanil International Finance, Baden-Wurttembergische Bank AG, Banco Central Hispano London Branch, Bank Austria Aktiengesellschaft, Bank of Commmerce Labuan, Banque Francaise du Commerce Exterieur Hong Kong, Coryo Merchant Bank, Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino S.p.A, Overseas Chinese Banking Corp, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia Singapore, Saehan Merchant Banking Corp, and Development Bank of Singapore.

Managers are Berliner Bank. Banca Mazionale del Lavoro S.p.A, Hong Kong, China Everbright Singapore Investment Co Pte Ltd. KIMB Finance, KLBI London, Kookmin Finance Asia, Agricultural Bank of China Hong Kong, Commercial Bank of Korea, Credit Italiano S.p.A Hong Kong, Public Bank, Hong Kong Chinese Bank and Siam Commercial Bank PCL Hong Kong.
